technical.title: QK-Bench benchmarks quantitative kinematic understanding for dynamic spatial intelligence
technical.summary: Researchers introduce QK-Bench to study quantitative kinematic understanding in multimodal large language models, resolving motion magnitude, rate, reference-frame dependence, and future spatial evolution.
technical.why: This is critical for safety in collision avoidance, trajectory tracking, and autonomous driving.

technical.title: DexEngine scales human demonstrations into physically executable whole-robot data
technical.summary: DexEngine is a simulation pipeline that converts human hand-object demonstrations into train-ready, physically executable arm-hand trajectories using placement, arm motion finding, and residual reinforcement learning.
technical.why: It provides a scalable way to generate robot manipulation data from human demonstrations.

technical.title: Skeptic grounds failure diagnosis for robot skill discovery
technical.summary: Researchers study how execution failures are diagnosed and which lessons enter shared skill libraries, noting that agents can fail by misinterpreting an unsuccessful program as physical impossibility.
technical.why: It addresses fundamental bottlenecks in autonomous robotic skill acquisition and program revision.

technical.title: ELITE enables evaluation-free recursive self-improvement for coding agents
technical.summary: Researchers introduce Explore-then-Integrate (ELITE) to allow coding agents to self-improve without requiring downstream task evaluation inside the evolution loop, avoiding evaluation costs and benchmark-specific adaptation.
technical.why: This helps engineers scale coding agent optimization without incurring heavy execution overhead.

technical.title: Integral unifies visual understanding and generation in vision-language models
technical.summary: Researchers propose Integral, which creates a shared visual representation space to convert a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model capable of both understanding and generation.
technical.why: It offers a path to build unified multimodal models by overcoming heterogeneous visual representations.

technical.title: Deep learning approaches benchmarked for scalable mangrove mapping using Sentinel imagery
technical.summary: Researchers benchmark deep learning segmentation approaches for large-scale mangrove mapping using free, regularly available Sentinel-1 radar and Sentinel-2 optical imagery instead of costly very-high-resolution data.
technical.why: It provides practical insights for remote sensing and environmental monitoring applications.

technical.title: AVQFormer brings semantics-first approach to multimodal video captioning
technical.summary: The Audio-Visual Query Transformer (AVQFormer) builds on a 2.7B parameter LLM with a fixed-length semantic alignment module, stabilized via Adaptive Self-Critical Sequence Training with Entropy Regularization.
technical.why: It advances efficient multimodal video understanding using frozen encoders.

technical.title: Confidence-based adaptive retrieval fails in biomedical question answering
technical.summary: Evaluating confidence-based adaptive RAG across biomedical QA benchmarks reveals a paradox: confidence is well-calibrated on standard medical exam questions where retrieval adds little value, but fails where it matters most.
technical.why: It highlights critical limitations of confidence-routing retrieval strategies in high-stakes domains.

technical.title: RegHarness regulates persistence for code-as-policy robot agents
technical.summary: RegHarness is a two-level harness that governs step-level execution and cross-run adaptation for Code-as-Policy agent teams without relying on a VLA policy or demonstrations.
technical.why: It improves governance and persistence control for robotic agents executing generated code.

technical.title: OpenAI and Cisco release Shirudo for agent-driven system defense
technical.summary: OpenAI and Cisco released Shirudo, a BSD-licensed eBPF runtime for Linux that allows AI agents to write signed shields blocking exploit paths on running systems prior to full patch deployment.
technical.why: It introduces a novel framework for runtime agentic cybersecurity defense.

business.title: Beware higher correlation but nab high U.S. credit yields, fund managers say
business.summary: The AI boom could trigger a recession, but data centers remain an attractive investment opportunity, a hedge fund manager said.

business.title: Latin America has the copper and energy the AI build-out needs. Infrastructure is the test
business.summary: Latin America’s copper, oil, gas and rare earths could benefit from rising AI energy demand, if infrastructure and fiscal policy attract investment.

business.title: Tech stocks sink but close well off the lows, Anthropic struggles to rebound above IPO price
business.summary: Nvidia and other AI-linked stocks fell as investors weighed AI spending, inflation and higher-rate risks.

business.title: The questions Jensen Huang and Nvidia will still have to answer about Megaspeed
business.summary: The central question for investigators is what Nvidia knew about where those chips ended up and whether Huang's affair with a Megaspeed executive gave the company reason to doubt Megaspeed's assurances.

business.title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, a worrying sign for AI startups
business.summary: Anthropic’s post-IPO slump could put pressure on AI startup valuations.

business.title: Why a Crusoe investor is betting on solar and batteries to power future AI data centers
business.summary: Next-generation data centers will need tens of gigawatts of power every year. One of Crusoe's investors thinks solar and energy storage are the obvious choice.

business.title: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space
business.summary: In an announcement on Wednesday, the FCC says it authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites as part of the Elon Musk-owned company's "Starmind" initiative. With several others also pursuing t

business.title: Amazon is reportedly in talks to end Muse AI shopping block
business.summary: Amazon has held talks about letting Meta's Muse AI agent shop on its online marketplace, according to a report from Fortune. The discussions, which could end Amazon's block on Muse, reportedly center on the kinds of prod

business.title: Your AI Startup’s Exit Is Being Shaped By The Deals You Sign Today
business.summary: When everything moves that fast, the terms of your financings and of your contracts for compute, data and distribution get set early and in a hurry. Some of those terms will later slow a sale, add cost and erode value.

business.title: Most Unicorns Are Worth More Than Their Last Funding-Round Valuations, Crunchbase Estimates
business.summary: The more than 1,900 startups on the The Crunchbase Unicorn Board have a combined valuation of roughly $9 trillion, based on their last reported valuations. But Crunchbase’s new Current Valuation Model, which estimates ho

models.title: Apple Releases Depth Pro 2 for Metric Monocular Depth Estimation
models.summary: Apple introduces Depth Pro 2, which estimates sharp, temporally consistent metric depth from ordinary photos, videos, or live camera feeds at full resolution.
models.why: It provides state-of-the-art monocular depth estimation critical for computer vision and autonomous systems.

models.title: LlamaIndex Releases OCRia-nano-1 for Fast CPU Document Parsing
models.summary: OCRia-nano-1 is an 8.1M-parameter distilled document parsing pipeline from LlamaIndex that runs on CPU, achieving high accuracy and parsing 27.8 pages per second.
models.why: It offers an efficient, high-speed document OCR and layout analysis solution for local deployment.

models.title: NVIDIA Introduces Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation for Agentic Visual Generation
models.summary: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation is an agentic framework using a Pixel as Code interface to generate and edit raster images, webpages, charts, and scientific figures.
models.why: It introduces a novel approach for agents to synthesize and inspect complex visual artifacts.

models.title: Prism ML Releases Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B GGUF for Agents
models.summary: Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B is a new agentic model retaining a 1.76 bits per weight ternary format, offering FP16-level tool-calling performance at a fraction of the size.
models.why: It delivers high-efficiency agentic tool-calling capabilities suitable for resource-constrained environments.

models.title: InclusionAI Releases Ling-3.2-air Multimodal Workflow Automation Model
models.summary: Ling-3.2-air is a new open-weight multimodal model with strong improvements in workflow automation, document reasoning, and terminal-based tasks compared to its predecessor.
models.why: It advances open multimodal capabilities for document understanding and automated tasks.

models.title: Harness-Hub Releases RL-Trained LoRA Adapter for Qwen3.8-27B Coding Agent
models.summary: A new reinforcement learning-trained LoRA adapter for Qwen3.8-27B matches high-effort reasoning performance on terminal and software tasks while generating 4.5x fewer tokens.
models.why: It drastically reduces token overhead while maintaining high performance on software-engineering benchmarks.
